erros.naoSuportado: Your browser doesn't support speech recognition. Use Chrome, Edge, or Safari, or type your question.
erros.inseguro: The microphone only works on a secure connection (HTTPS or localhost).
erros.permissao: The browser isn't allowing microphone access for this site. Click the lock or microphone icon in the address bar, allow access, and reload the page.
erros.sistema: The operating system is blocking the microphone for the browser. On Windows, check Settings > Privacy > Microphone (including the option for desktop apps). On macOS, check System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone.
erros.servico: The browser blocked the speech recognition service even though the microphone is available. Try Chrome or Edge, and turn off extensions or blockers that prevent audio from being sent.
erros.semMicrofone: No microphone was found. Check that it is connected and selected in your sound settings.
erros.emUso: The microphone is being used by another application. Close it and try again.
erros.semFala: I didn't hear anything. Tap the microphone and try again.
erros.rede: Network error during speech recognition. Check your connection.
erros.generico: Couldn't capture your voice. Please try again.
